rationale: OCDS publisher registry: mine once to establish whether ME publishes machine-readable procurement data, not a continuous ME signal stream.
Montenegro not in Opentender coverage; only value is RS/MK benchmarking and reusable scraper code, and URL did not verify.
World Bank GPPD Montenegro profile is a standalone normalised procurement dataset useful for baselining buyer concentration.
National open-data portal tender datasets with API access — the free structured baseline for ME procurement data; legally allowed.
Single 2024 MAPS assessment PDF: authoritative one-off evidence on what CeJN actually publishes, not a recurring feed.
DRI audit-report archive is a durable, filterable multi-year series of procurement findings; failed fetch is a soft signal only.
Single DRI IT-audit news item on one entity — valuable evidence on state IT procurement, but the parent DRI archive is the monitorable source.
One 2015-16 annual audit report PDF; the recurring series is covered by monitoring the DRI archive.
Institut alternativa news archive is a continuously producing hub for procurement-monitoring analyses and a good snowball spine.
mojnovac.me structured budget-execution database sizes IT/services spending of bank-adjacent public buyers; derived data no portal offers.
Municipal budget portal covers the weakest-coverage direct-award layer, but URL did not verify — recheck liveness before approving.
One-off 2016 NIS assessment PDF; useful calibration metadata on oversight bodies, not a producing source.
Balkan Tender Watch ME section gives ongoing regional comparative procurement analysis unavailable from any national source.
Anti-corruption agency site publishes recurring reports and its own procurement plan; failed verification is soft, worth tracking.
X account is only a low-value latency trigger for ASK PDFs and X access/ToS make automated collection unreliable.
CGO/CCE produces recurring municipal-procurement studies and hosts a large PDF library; complements IA and MANS.
CIN-CG investigations category reconstructs contracts and IT-sector money flows that never surface on the primary portal.
SIGMA/OECD Montenegro country page is a multi-year, methodologically consistent assessment series of the procurement system.
OGP member page delivers periodic IRM evaluations explaining gaps in procurement transparency commitments.
gov.me document archive publishes FOI-released contracts and annexes never proactively disclosed; explicitly allowed.
Legacy parliamentary FOI directory adds legislature-side released documents; static-ish but a distinct standalone archive.
Dan runs recurring aggregate procurement-accountability reporting with hard figures; fast channel for tender controversy.
Vijesti is the leading independent daily and expected home of contract-award and cancelled-tender reporting for ME.
